load_scope: Only exact canonical existing library via RTLD_NOLOAD; revalidate aliases/dev/inode/size/mtime and all symbol addresses in exact executable mappings before and after queries. No generic library search or fallback. Context device UUID/name/total bind Torch selected device; same boot/host total/hugetlb0 required.
attestation_limit: Existing runtime02 carries metadata pins, not a libcuda payload SHA. No DSO payload is read/hashed during source-only preparation. This authority does not claim cryptographic attestation of all driver bytes.
